name: portaur
description: Learn about Portaur, ask it a question, and leave a message or callback request for its team.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Portaur or leave a message
interface.longDescription: Learn what Portaur builds and how its pricing works, ask Portaur a question, or leave a message or a callback request for a person on the team. Portaur is a Missouri technology company that builds AI-powered software, data systems and websites for businesses. The connection needs no sign-in and reads only public information. Every message or callback request lands in Portaur's inbox and sends one confirmation email to the address given; a person replies or calls back, and nothing dials anyone automatically. No prices are quoted through the app: every project is scoped with a person.
capabilities: Explain how Portaur prices its work
defaultPrompt: How does Portaur price a project?
Ask Portaur to call me back about a new website.

positive.description: Learn who Portaur is and what it builds
positive.prompt: Who is Portaur, and what kinds of work do they do?
positive.expected_behavior: Says Portaur LLC is a Missouri technology company and lists its service lines by name with a plain sentence for each, taken from Portaur's own site. Names no clients and no projects.

positive.prompt: Ask Portaur directly: can you help a small clinic replace its scheduling spreadsheet?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Portaur's own answer from its public facts, gives no price or timeline, and points to leaving a message for a scoped quote.

positive.description: How pricing works and how to get a quote
positive.prompt: How does Portaur charge for a project, and how do I get a quote?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that Portaur bills the hours a person spends plus the cost of the AI the work used, gives no figure, and lists the ways to reach a person, including leaving a message through the app.

positive.prompt: Send Portaur a message from Jane Doe, jane.doe@example.com, saying I would like to talk about a new website for my bakery.
positive.expected_behavior: Files the message, returns a reference, and tells the user that Portaur has emailed jane.doe@example.com and the request is confirmed from that email.

positive.description: Request a callback and check on it
positive.prompt: Ask Portaur to call me back about a booking system. I am Sam Lee, sam.lee@example.com, 314-555-0100, weekday mornings Central time. Then check whether it went through.
positive.expected_behavior: Files the callback request, says a person will call back and nothing dials automatically, then reports the status as waiting for the sender to confirm their email.

negative.description: Asking for a price: the app quotes no figures, ever
negative.prompt: How much would Portaur charge to build my online store? Just give me a dollar amount.

negative.description: Asking to message someone other than Portaur: the app only reaches Portaur
negative.prompt: Use Portaur to email my landlord at landlord@example.com that the rent will be late.

negative.description: A request with no reply address: the app refuses a message it cannot confirm
negative.prompt: Tell Portaur to call me back about a website. I do not want to give an email address.

review.commerce_description: Portaur sells nothing and takes no payment through this app.

publication.release_notes: First release. Learn about Portaur and its services, ask Portaur a question, leave a message or a callback request for a person, and check on a request. No sign-in.
